card.name: Pharmacokinetic effect phrases and drug-name interiors
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction and pharmacology text just before an effect is named, such as "effect on metabolism", "reduction in", "half-life", and partway through drug or medical terms like misoprostol, mifepristone and steatorrhea.

modes.label: Effect wording
modes.description: Words that link an interacting drug to a changed measure, such as metabolism, plasma levels or half-life.
modes.example: prolonged the half<<-life>> of avanafil to approximately 9

modes.description: Middle pieces of drug names or medical terms.
modes.example: diclofenac sodium and misop<<rost>>ol delayed-release tablets, 75
